# Synthetic extraction fixtures

All names, identities, worker references, quantities and sums are invented. No uploaded business attachment, credential, real bank transfer, customer or employee data is included. The examples represent materials delivered to a project, subcontract acceptance/warranty and weekly direct crew details. They are parser suggestions only; every result requires accountant review and existing party/contract selection.

The materials workbook stores monetary values as decimal text. Parsing never computes VAT, allowance, payroll or rounding policy. Original numeric XML is read exactly when present. Formula caches are ignored. Multiple-sheet basis selection remains a manual review case; no silent cross-sheet merge.

PDF/photo examples remain unavailable until a separately approved OCR provider or verified text parser is integrated. The synthetic PDF is an inert text page. Image examples contain metadata only. Unsupported or large/macro/external-link workbooks return bounded errors, retaining the original.

fixture-manifest.json contains reviewed byte lengths, SHA256 and archive member names for the generated synthetic workbook/PDF files.
